security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, localhost URLs, and resource path formatting. Two filesystem findings are confirmed because the replay guide writes production workflow histories to local files. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Production workflow histories may contain sensitive data.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to redact histories, restrict file permissions, avoid committing artifacts, and prefer synthetic histories when possible.

remediation.issue: History export examples write to unconstrained paths.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain outputs to a dedicated directory, validate filenames, and reject workflow IDs with path separators.

remediation.issue: CI example downloads production histories during pull request checks.
remediation.suggestion: Document required access controls and avoid running production export jobs for untrusted pull requests.

content.value_statement: Temporal workflow tests can be slow, flaky, and hard to structure. This skill gives pytest patterns for unit, integration, replay, and local server testing.
actual_capabilities: Explains pytest fixtures for Temporal workflow and activity tests.
Shows time-skipping patterns for long-running workflow logic.
Guides integration tests with mocked activities and error injection.
Covers replay testing against exported workflow histories.
Provides local Temporal server, coverage, and CI setup patterns.
limitations: It does not execute tests or validate results automatically.
Examples must be adapted to each project structure and workflow type.
Production replay histories may need redaction and access controls.
It assumes familiarity with Python, pytest, and Temporal concepts.

use_cases.title: Add Fast Workflow Tests
use_cases.description: Create pytest coverage for long-running Temporal workflows using time-skipping and clear assertions.

use_cases.title: Mock External Activity Behavior
use_cases.description: Design integration tests that isolate workflow logic while simulating activity success, retries, and failures.

use_cases.title: Validate Workflow Changes Before Release
use_cases.description: Plan replay tests and CI checks that catch nondeterministic workflow changes before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Workflow Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me a basic pytest pattern for a Temporal Python workflow. Use time-skipping and explain the fixture responsibilities.

prompt_templates.title: Mock Activities in Integration Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an integration test for my workflow with mocked activities. Include error injection and assertions for retry behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Build Replay Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan replay tests before changing a production Temporal workflow. Include history selection, determinism checks, and safe data handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complete Test Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Temporal Python test suite structure. Recommend unit, integration, replay, local server, and CI coverage improvements.

output_examples.input: I need a fast test for a workflow that waits several days.
output_examples.output: The response recommends a time-skipping environment, an async pytest fixture, and assertions for final state and side effects.

output_examples.input: I changed workflow logic and need deployment confidence.
output: Select representative workflow histories for replay.
Run replay tests with the updated workflow code.
Investigate nondeterminism before releasing the change.

output_examples.input: My team needs a local Temporal testing setup.
output_examples.output: The response outlines a Docker-based Temporal server, pytest configuration, coverage reporting, and common development commands.

best_practices: Use time-skipping for workflow tests that would otherwise wait for real timers.
Mock activities when testing workflow control flow and retry behavior.
Replay representative histories before changing deployed workflow definitions.
anti_patterns: Calling real external APIs directly from workflow code during tests.
Relying only on end-to-end tests for Temporal workflow coverage.
Saving production histories without redaction, access limits, or retention rules.

faq.question: Does this skill run Temporal tests for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides testing patterns and setup guidance that you adapt and run in your project.

faq.question: Can it help with time-skipping tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to use Temporal test environments to avoid real timer delays.

faq.question: Does it cover activity mocking?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes integration patterns for mocked activities, error injection, retries, and assertions.

faq.question: Can it support replay testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes replay testing with exported workflow histories and version compatibility checks.

faq.question: Is it limited to local development?
faq.answer: No. It also includes CI patterns, coverage targets, and deployment validation workflows.

faq.question: What should I protect when using replay histories?
faq.answer: Protect workflow inputs, results, and identifiers. Redact sensitive data and restrict access to exported files.
